description: Access AlphaPortal (AlphaRoute) school-bus data — students, stops, live bus GPS location, arrival notifications — from a shell with curl instead of running the alphaportal-mcp server. Capture the signed-in web app's refresh token ONCE (a paste-in-console one-liner, or the fpx browser bridge), then mint access tokens and curl the REST API directly. Use when you want AlphaPortal data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
